Subtracting 359 days from 1243-01-19:  
1243 is not a leap year (1243 mod 4 = 3).  
359 days before Jan 19, 1243 → go back into 1242.  
From Jan 19 back 18 days → Jan 1, 1243.  
Remaining 341 days back into 1242: 1242 is a common year, so from Dec 31, 1242 back 341 days → 341 − 31 (Dec) = 310 left, 310 − 30 (Nov) = 280, 280 − 31 (Oct) = 249, 249 − 30 (Sep) = 219, 219 − 31 (Aug) = 188, 188 − 31 (Jul) = 157, 157 − 30 (Jun) = 127, 127 − 31 (May) = 96, 96 − 30 (Apr) = 66, 66 − 31 (Mar) = 35, 35 − 28 (Feb 1242) = 7, so 7 days before Feb 28 → Feb 21, 1242.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1242-02-21
